feeds.title: Atlanta Black Star
feeds.description: Explore the latest news and coverage of trending topics from the Atlanta Black Star. Featuring news that empowers narratives to change our world. Atlanta Black Star is a narrative company. We publish narratives intentionally and specifically to enlighten and transform the world.

feeds.title: Atlanta Film and TV Blog
feeds.description: Atlanta Film and TV is a leading media outlet dedicated to promoting and celebrating the film industry in Atlanta, Georgia. Through engaging content, interviews, and behind-the-scenes coverage, Atlanta Film and TV is a comprehensive platform for industry professionals, enthusiasts, and audiences alike.

feeds.title: Bossip
feeds.description: Bossip is the destination for African-American popular culture and entertainment, with a voice that's edgy, viciously hilarious, politically aware, and completely unique. Bossip draws a loyal following of young and influential trend setters who are up to date with what's hot in society, and has been most recently mentioned by many top news outlets.

feeds.title: Urban Belle Magazine
feeds.description: Urban Belle is quickly becoming one of the fastest growing sites for black celebrities, black celebrity news, urban gossip, and the rawest source for what's hot in today's black culture. Praised for its straight up and no chaser content, there is simply no other online magazine for black women on the internet this dope.

feeds.title: Rolling Out » Entertainment
feeds.description: Get the latest gossip and entertainment news from Rolling Out. Immerse yourself in the glitz and glam of entertainment events, award shows, and film festivals. Rolling Out is the top resource for breaking black news, celebrity videos, entertainment, business, and more.

feeds.title: Vox ATL » Entertainment
feeds.description: Movie Reviews, Entertainment news, and opinions on cultural movements around Atlanta. Vox ATL is an uncensored source of teen publication and self-expression, and Atlanta's home for teens from all academic, geographic, race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, disability, life experience, and socioeconomic backgrounds.

feeds.title: ATL Cheap Date Blog
feeds.description: A loose guide to cheap and free entertainment and attractions in and around Atlanta. This site catalogs weekly, seasonal, and year-round events and also shares additional tidbits and teasers. Discover the magic of Atlanta's immersive experiences through the eyes of an Atlanta-based writer.

feeds.title: Straight From The A
feeds.description: Straight From The A is Atlanta Entertainment Industry Gossip & News: Atlanta's Most Reliable Source of Entertainment Gossip! Get fast, zippy, and mind-blowing facts and gossip right here.

feeds.title: The Black Media
feeds.description: Featuring unbiased celebrity news, film, music, beauty, food, pop culture, and news. TheBLACKMedia is an Independently Black Owned Entertainment & News Publication created by entertainer Tahir C. Register, geared towards the millennial and z generations. It is dedicated to exclusively reporting and producing content about and for People Of Colour
